title: WaterSound Compass Point II-421 "Southern Roots" - 37 Compass Pt. Way
h1: WaterSound Compass Point II-421 "Southern Roots" - 37 Compass Pt. Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf Front- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Private deeded beach access- Free WiFi- Newly renovated in 2024- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 1 designated parking space. This condo permits a maximum of 1 vehicle through the community security gate.DETAILS: Southern Roots is a stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom luxury condo that sleeps 7 in the highly sought-after gated community of Compass Point in WaterSound. This Gulf-front home provides access to community amenities, including 3 pools, gas grills, and more. Guests will love having over 2,000 square feet of living space, along with 2 balconies overlooking the Emerald Coast. WaterSound guests have access to all the community boardwalks that lead to the beach!As guests enter the main floor of this stunning 3-story condo, a wall of oversized windows allows natural lighting to flow into the great room for an inviting atmosphere. The soaring 2-story living area captures panoramic vistas of the Gulf and Dune Lake and is furnished with a cozy couch, 2 armchairs, and a 65” Smart TV. Enjoy balcony access with bar seating for the perfect sunrise coffee or sunset cocktail. The adjoining dining area offers guests stunning views on a mix of chair and bench seating for 6, while the adjacent breakfast bar seats 4 more. The open kitchen is accented with custom cabinetry and luxury Viking appliances, including an oversized Viking refrigerator with a separate freeze drawer. There is a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a 55” Smart TV located on the main floor.Downstairs, guests will find the 2 remaining bedrooms—1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom, and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and access to a private balcony with a café table and chair set. There’s also a washer and dryer on the first floor.The top floor of this stunning home provides a versatile space for a secondary entertainment area, or it can be utilized for additional sleep arrangements.Get ready to soak in the fantastic views and luxurious amenities at Southern Roots! With on-site parking for 1 vehicle —plus 3 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the local area. Enjoy all the WaterSound boardwalks that lead to beach access.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 7):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Room*From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion.Low-Speed Vehicles: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW.- Unfortunately due to HOA rules the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart.- If the home you are renting has a golf cart provided by the owner then please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations.- If we have not received the proper insurance and driver's license information then YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO USE THE GOLF CART.- Lastly, if a person without a valid driver's license is found to have operated the golf cart provided, or is found driving in a reckless manner then the guest will be fined a $750.00 charge.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

Way Watersound, FL Bedrooms 3 Beds 4 Sleeps 7 Full Baths 3 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Gulf Front - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella) - Private deeded beach access - Free WiFi - Newly renovated in 2024 - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This property comes with 1 designated parking space. This condo permits a maximum of 1 vehicle through the community security gate. DETAILS: Southern Roots is a stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom luxury condo that sleeps 7 in the highly sought-after gated community of Compass Point in WaterSound. This Gulf-front home provides access to community amenities, including 3 pools, gas grills, and more. Guests will love having over 2,000 square feet of living space, along with 2 balconies overlooking the Emerald Coast. WaterSound guests have access to all the community boardwalks that lead to the beach! As guests enter the main floor of this stunning 3-story condo, a wall of oversized windows allows natural lighting to flow into the great room for an inviting atmosphere. The soaring 2-story living area captures panoramic vistas of the Gulf and Dune Lake and is furnished with a cozy couch, 2 armchairs, and a 65” Smart TV. Enjoy balcony access with bar seating for the perfect sunrise coffee or sunset cocktail. The adjoining dining area offers guests stunning views on a mix of chair and bench seating for 6, while the adjacent breakfast bar seats 4 more. The open kitchen is accented with custom cabinetry and luxury Viking appliances, including an oversized Viking refrigerator with a separate freeze drawer. There is a guest bedroom with a queen bed and a 55” Smart TV located on the main floor. Downstairs, guests will find the 2 remaining bedrooms—1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and private bathroom, and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and access to a private balcony with a café table and chair set. There’s also a washer and dryer on the first floor. The top floor of this stunning home provides a versatile space for a secondary entertainment area, or it can be utilized for additional sleep arrangements. Get ready to soak in the fantastic views and luxurious amenities at Southern Roots! With on-site parking for 1 vehicle —plus 3 complimentary adult bikes—it’s easy to explore the local area. Enjoy all the WaterSound boardwalks that lead to beach access. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 7): FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Room *From October 2025 through 2026, WaterSound Compass Point will undergo major exterior refurbishment. Residents and guests should expect construction, boarded windows, limited balcony and garage access, and possible parking disruptions. These safety measures are essential for project completion. Low-Speed Vehicles: IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW. - Unfortunately due to HOA rules the guest will not be able to rent golf carts and will not be able to bring their own golf cart. - If the home you are renting has a golf cart provided by the owner then please be aware of the golf cart rules and regulations. - If we have not received the proper insurance and driver's license information then YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO USE THE GOLF CART. - Lastly, if a person without a valid driver's license is found to have operated the golf cart provided, or is found driving in a reckless manner then the guest will be fined a $750.00 charge. *Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
